context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the tdd-process instructions from the published Ruby Core Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Write a failing test for the target behavior

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run the test suite on that specific file

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Gate:** Failure must be on the assertion — not a syntax or configuration error

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Write the minimal code required to pass the test — nothing more

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Run the test suite after each micro-change

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Gate:** Tests must remain green throughout
